items.rationale: Section 5.2.6(b) covers inspection to establish the cause and extent of the loss. The €524 gross reference estimate is below the €3,000 assessment limit; the €500 deductible applies once to the event, not to each line.

Section 5.2.6(a) covers indoor leak location. Allow €500 gross for the detection work, excluding the technician time and vehicle charge billed separately; lines 2 and 3 together total €650, below the €1,000 limit.
Section 5.2.6(a) covers on-site technician time. At €60 gross per hour, 2.5 hours is €150; no reduction under the shared €1,000 leak-location limit is needed.
Section 5.2.6(c) allows one vehicle charge on this contractor's invoice. The €79 gross reference estimate is below the €83.30 gross cap at 19% VAT.

items.description: Repair of two actively leaking copper joints
items.rationale: Section 2.4.3 expressly treats age-related leakage as fracture damage for sections verified to be leaking. Under 7.1.1(b), €330 gross allows for local sealing or renewal of the two joints, not replacement of the run.

items.description: Precautionary replacement of non-leaking copper run
items.rationale: Sections 2.4.3 and 7.1.5 exclude pipe sections not shown to be leaking; age alone does not make preventive replacement an insured repair. The positive amount is a rough gross estimate only if the work were accepted.

Section 7.1.9 excludes the upgrade difference, and the precautionary replacement to which it relates is also outside 2.4.3. The positive amount is a rough conditional estimate of the surcharge, not an allowance.

Section 5.2.6(c) allows the plumber's single vehicle charge for attending the covered joint repair, separately from the leak-detection firm's charge. The €79 gross reference estimate is below the €83.30 gross cap at 19% VAT.
